title: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
hook: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania

beats.caption: Two unvaccinated people die of measles in Pennsylvania
Imagine a forgotten lock suddenly breaking on your front door.
beats.narration: Imagine a lock that worked for decades suddenly failing. That is what is happening with measles right now.

beats.caption: Two people have died from measles in Pennsylvania.
beats.narration: Two people in Pennsylvania have died from measles. Both were unvaccinated.

beats.caption: Measles cases have hit their highest point in years.
beats.narration: This comes as US measles cases hit their highest point since the virus was declared eliminated.

beats.caption: Falling vaccination rates are opening the door for outbreaks.
beats.narration: The primary driver is a steady decline in vaccination rates across the country.

beats.caption: Measles is extremely contagious and spreads fast.
beats.detail: It poses a serious health threat.
beats.narration: Measles is incredibly contagious, which makes high vaccination coverage essential for everyone.

beats.caption: Stay informed on local health updates.
beats.narration: Health experts are urging people to check their vaccination records and stay updated.
